text:
Type: large red mosaic wool rug
Use: anchoring a large seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, traditional, rustic
Materials: wool, low textured pile
Colors: deep red, pink, cream, green, navy accents
Shape: rectangular, large diamond medallion with scattered geometric tile motifs, no border, oversized, bold
Feel: warm, vibrant, eclectic, cozy
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey or neutral upholstery, woven baskets; bohemian or eclectic rooms

product.name: Rivet Red Mosaic Multi-Print Wool Rug, 7'10" x 11', Red
product.description: Pile: 100% Wool, Backing: 100% Canvas Imported The vibrant red in this tribal print rug is sure to make a bold style statement in any room. Its intricate details and beautifully matched color palette create a bold centerpiece for neutral décor. Tribal design in red 100% wool fibers hand-tufted in India Medium, .65'' pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 7'10" x 11' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for fibers to settle
